summary: GATE 1 (LEAD pre-approval) PASSES with 4 named conditions. No duplicate instrument exists for the SD's core scope and no colliding in-flight SD exists. The blocking question asked (feedback.category constrained by enum/CHECK?) is REFUTED — category is unconstrained varchar(50), zero CHECK constraints reference it, 58 distinct values live. However the SD's headline duplicate-check claim is REFUTED AS WRITTEN (8+ longitudinal series instruments exist, one over merge_witness_telemetry which the SD names as its own source), a live-but-dormant trend function already exists over issue_patterns (T3's target), T2's named source session_coordination provably cannot carry a series, and the closest precedent is two COMPLETED trend-detector SDs whose scripts nothing schedules.

critical_issues.title: T2 source session_coordination CANNOT carry a longitudinal series — the codebase already forbids it in writing
critical_issues.evidence: lib/coordination/answered-rate.cjs:3-8 — 'READ THE LEDGER, NEVER session_coordination. cleanup_expired_coordination() deletes ACKED rows at created+24h while UNACKED rows persist, so a survivor-table rate measures the deletion policy rather than anyone's conduct. Measured 2026-07-31: 0 of 31 acked rows survived 24h against 1,930 unacked that did.' Live corroboration (measured 2026-08-07 via SUPABASE_POOLER_URL): session_coordination holds 3,725 rows spanning only 2026-07-24 to 2026-08-07, of which 3,143 (84%) are from the last 7 days. It is a biased survivor set.
critical_issues.remediation: The durable source EXISTS and the SD does not name it: retention_archive holds 44,003 rows with source_table='session_coordination' spanning 2026-03-11 to 2026-08-06 (row_data jsonb). Archive-before-delete INSERT at database/migrations/20260713_fix_cleanup_expired_coordination_where_clause.sql:38-42. T2 must read retention_archive UNION session_coordination. Still zero new tables. Reading session_coordination alone yields a series that measures the cleanup policy, not recurrence — the exact class of defect this SD exists to detect.
critical_issues.blocking_for: PLAN — must be a named PRD requirement with a two-sided test

critical_issues.title: Prior art for T3: a live trend detector over issue_patterns already exists, has zero callers, and reads an empty table
critical_issues.evidence: database/migrations/20260110_pattern_intelligence.sql:55 calculate_pattern_trends() — counts pattern_occurrences in last 7 days vs prior 30-day weekly average; >1.5x sets issue_patterns.trend='increasing', <0.5x sets 'decreasing'. VERIFIED LIVE in pg_proc (proname='calculate_pattern_trends', no args). Zero callers: no JS/mjs/cjs, no workflow, no npm script invokes it. AND pattern_occurrences has 0 rows live — so even if invoked it computes nothing. Meanwhile issue_patterns.trend IS populated (stable=1206, decreasing=401, increasing=38, new=36; newest write 2026-08-07T10:44Z) by a DIFFERENT writer, the decay marker at scripts/detect-stale-patterns.js:104-120. Sibling view: database/migrations/20260102_pattern_metrics.sql:318 v_pattern_health_dashboard.trend, also unread by any JS.
critical_issues.remediation: T3 must reconcile with this before writing a competing number. Two shipped-but-unwired trend mechanisms already write/claim the issue_patterns.trend column; a third derivation makes the column mean three things. PLAN should either (a) explicitly scope T3 away from issue_patterns.trend and own only the lane-named-classes-reaching-issue_patterns RATIO, or (b) retire/adopt calculate_pattern_trends. Do not silently add a fourth writer.

critical_issues.title: SD names a data source that does not exist: 'chairman_decisions + captures'
critical_issues.evidence: chairman_decisions EXISTS (662 rows, 2026-05-22 to 2026-08-07). No table named chairman_decision_captures / chairman_captures exists. Enumerated all 30 public tables matching '%chairman%' or '%captur%': nearest live objects are chairman_decision_audit, chairman_unified_decisions, chairman_all_decision_signals, venture_capture_snapshots — plus a feedback CATEGORY named 'chairman_decision_capture' (10 live rows), which is probably what was meant.
critical_issues.remediation: PLAN must resolve which object 'captures' refers to before the PRD names a read source. Most likely feedback WHERE category='chairman_decision_capture'.

critical_issues.title: Closest precedent is a cautionary one: two COMPLETED trend-detector SDs shipped scripts that nothing schedules
critical_issues.evidence: SD-LEO-INFRA-CONSULTANT-AGENT-PHASE-001 ('Trend Snapshot Validation', completed) and SD-LEO-INFRA-CONSULTANT-AGENT-PHASE-002 ('LLM Trend Detector', completed) shipped scripts/eva/eva-trend-snapshot.mjs (ISO-week bucketing :27, rolling-4-week velocity :132, persists to eva_consultant_snapshots :271) and scripts/eva/trend-detector.mjs (14-day window, upsert to eva_consultant_trends :240). BOTH verified UNWIRED — no npm script, no .github/workflows entry. Also unwired: lib/learning/feedback-clusterer.js, scripts/solomon/measure-chairman-sms-invisibility.mjs (the ONLY consumer of readChairmanSmsExchanges, and it persists nothing).
critical_issues.remediation: This is exactly the failure the SD's own success criterion #6 (consumer-side proof at completion) is written against. Keep that criterion; it is load-bearing, not ceremonial. The matching in-repo lesson is at .github/workflows/solomon-judgment-expiry.yml:22-25 — 'the first version of FR-2 shipped a pure selector with no runner and no entry, and I described it as ships disabled. Retro review pointed out that is not a disabled mechanism, it is an ABSENT one.'
critical_issues.blocking_for: none — reinforces an existing success criterion

warnings.title: feedback insert contract will 23514 a naive cron writer
warnings.detail: feedback has 4 NOT NULL columns with NO default: type, source_application, source_type, title. Two are CHECK-constrained: feedback_type_check restricts type to {issue, enhancement} (a trend candidate is semantically neither — the writer must still pick one); feedback_source_type_check restricts source_type to {manual_feedback, auto_capture, uat_failure, error_capture, uncaught_exception, unhandled_rejection, manual_capture, todoist_intake, youtube_intake, claude_code_intake, telegram, user_feedback} — 'auto_capture' is the only defensible value for a GHA cron. feedback_severity_check restricts severity to {critical, high, medium, low} when supplied. Name this insert contract in the PRD or the first real cron run fails with a check violation.

warnings.title: readChairmanSmsExchanges gives T1 the READ but explicitly refuses the CLUSTERING
warnings.detail: lib/solomon/chairman-sms-exchanges.js:43-46 — 'Correlation is CHRONOLOGICAL ADJACENCY per counterpart phone, NOT similarity.' It returns flat counts (:138-144) with no buckets and no question-classes. T1 requires clustering inbound chairman SMS by question-class, which is a NEW capability. The SD's 'reused, not re-derived' claim is half true: the bounded read is reusable, the clustering is not. Also note the reader throws on query error rather than returning [] (:117-120) — good, preserve that; and sms_relay_staging uses received_at, NOT created_at (verified: the table has no created_at column at all).

warnings.title: New feedback category lands in a channel with a demonstrated drain failure
warnings.detail: Live measured 2026-08-07: harness_backlog=5,813 rows, invariant_gauge_finding=5,417, wind_down_survey=2,599, ci_failure=2,151. lib/governance/gauge-registry.js:399-412 records invariant_gauge_finding as 4,235 of 4,235 undrained and feedback_sla_breach as 'the alarm about undrained queues is ITSELF undrained'. A solomon_trend_candidate category with no closing path becomes the next row on that list. The SD's at-most-one-promoted-finding/day cap is the drain — make it a named PRD requirement with a DRAIN_DESCRIPTORS entry, and record what happens to UNpromoted candidates.

warnings.title: T1 source volume is thin — 340 rows total
warnings.detail: sms_relay_staging: 340 rows spanning 2026-07-17 to 2026-08-07 (21 days), ~15-28 inbound/day. Adequate for the founding specimen (a 2-member cluster 24h+ apart) but thin for statistical clustering. Reinforces the SD's own two-sided validation requirement: a seeded known-trend MUST fire and a seeded flat series MUST NOT — organic history alone will not exercise the detector at ship.

warnings.title: Wrong GHA template risk
warnings.detail: The SD names solomon-judgment-expiry.yml as part of 'the workflow pattern to copy'. That file ships DELIBERATELY DISABLED — its schedule: block is commented out and its runner refuses to write unless LEO_JUDGMENT_EXPIRY_ENABLED=1 AND --apply. Copying it yields a Trend-Eyes cron that never fires. Copy .github/workflows/solomon-ledger-reconcile.yml instead (daily cron '0 6 * * *', concurrency group, dry_run input) — it is the correct daily-scan template.

recommendations: NARROW the SD's duplicate-check claim before the LEAD-TO-PLAN handoff. Replace 'no current instrument owns longitudinal SERIES (gauges are point-event)' with the measured version: '22 of 25 entries in lib/governance/gauge-registry.js trip on count > 0 from a single condition. Longitudinal series instruments DO exist but are confined to other sources (recursion-governor.js, rung-health-convergence.mjs, witness-adoption.mjs, row-growth-snapshot.cjs). No instrument owns a longitudinal series over the chairman SMS lane, session_coordination, retrospectives, feedback categories, or chairman_decisions.'

CITE the codebase conceding the gap — lib/governance/gauge-registry.js:320 defines accumulationSignal as 'the alarm on the SERIES, distinct from the per-event signal — some failures are individually correct and only visible in aggregate', and :386 / :356 record it as 'MISSING'. :394 states 'Each refusal is individually CORRECT, so a per-event review finds nothing wrong — only the series exposes the outage.' This is stronger support for the SD than the claim it currently makes.

RESOLVE the merge_witness_telemetry overlap explicitly. lib/ship/witness-adoption.mjs:112 groupByDay / :131 computeAdoptionReadiness already builds a day-bucketed 60-day series with a consecutive-day streak over merge_witness_telemetry — a source the SD names as its own. Either drop merge_witness_telemetry from the v1 source list or state in the PRD what Trend-Eyes measures there that witness-adoption does not.

REUSE the proven series shape rather than inventing one: lib/governance/recursion-governor.js:53 computeRecursionRatio / :157 writeThroughputSnapshot / :140 fetchRecentSnapshots / :89 detectSustainedBreach is a complete write-snapshot -> read-back -> streak loop, wired via scripts/gauge-runner.mjs:288-296 and .github/workflows/gauge-runner-cron.yml. Also lib/vision/gauge-trend.js:39 computeGaugeTrend refuses to fabricate a trend at n<2 — copy that refusal for the run-receipt's flat-vs-dead distinction.

PRESERVE the read-only fence. SD-LEO-INFRA-CHAIRMAN-SMS-LANE-001 (completed) built lib/solomon/chairman-sms-exchanges.js with an explicit no-send-path boundary (:20-24) enforced two-sidedly by tests/unit/solomon/chairman-sms-no-send-path.test.js. That test is what mechanically enforces this SD's 'never messages the chairman' non-goal. Extend it to cover the new scan script rather than restating the fence in prose.
detailed_analysis:
VALIDATION GATE 1 (LEAD PRE-APPROVAL) — SD-LEO-INFRA-TREND-EYES-OFF-001
Method: live DB via SUPABASE_POOLER_URL (pg, information_schema + pg_constraint + pg_proc + pg_enum + pg_trigger), plus a very-thorough codebase sweep of scripts/ lib/ .github/workflows/ database/. All 179 workflows enumerated (104 carry a schedule: cron). Measured 2026-08-07.

== TASK 1: DUPLICATE / OVERLAP — claim PARTIALLY REFUTED, must be narrowed ==
The SD claims: 'existing gauge family checked — no current instrument owns longitudinal SERIES (gauges are point-event)'.
CONFIRMED for the point-event half: 22 of 25 entries in lib/governance/gauge-registry.js use thresholdConfig { tripWhen: (result) => (result?.count || 0) > 0 }. Only recursion-governor-ratio (:150), plan-drift-mix (:251), plan-drift-coverage (:236) and the generated loop-health-* (:160-170) differ.
CONFIRMED for the SD's own named sources: nothing owns a series over the chairman SMS lane, session_coordination, retrospectives, feedback categories, or chairman_decisions. No cron runs any chairman-SMS content analysis. No clusterer touches SMS (lib/learning/feedback-clusterer.js clusters by error_hash/QF title; lib/integrations/wave-clusterer.js, lib/fable-suitability/cluster-families.mjs are unrelated domains).
REFUTED as written: longitudinal series instruments DO exist. lib/governance/recursion-governor.js (rolling 30d ratio, snapshot append, >=3-tick streak; WIRED hourly). lib/ship/witness-adoption.mjs:131 (day-bucketed 60d series with consecutive-day streak over merge_witness_telemetry — A SOURCE THIS SD NAMES AS ITS OWN). lib/vision/rung-health-convergence.mjs:121 (least-squares slope over 14d, slopePerDay/converging/diverging/daysToZero). lib/vision/gauge-trend.js:39 (sparkline + signed delta over persisted snapshots). scripts/row-growth-snapshot.cjs (daily baseline series + anomaly-vs-previous; WIRED via row-growth-cron.yml). lib/governance/gauge-registry.js:251 (sustainedBreach across consecutive cycles). Plus two UNWIRED EVA series scripts.
RECURRENCE-AFTER-FIX (T2's class) already has a POINT-EVENT implementation: lib/learning/outcome-tracker.js:364 detectRecurrence jaccard-matches new feedback against resolved feedback whose resolution_sd_id completed inside the window and writes outcome_signals signal_type='pattern_recurrence' (:442). Triggered only from lib/eva/event-bus/handlers/feedback-created.js:33, whose own docblock (:12) warns direct-insert paths bypass it entirely. This is genuine prior art for the T2 CONCEPT at point-event granularity — the SD's series framing is the new part and is defensible, but the PRD must cite this rather than appear unaware of it. Related windowed-count (not series) implementations: scripts/lib/prod-error-recurrence-detector.mjs:115, scripts/lib/ci-recurrence-detector.mjs, scripts/adam-self-adherence-review.mjs:110-137 (which self-documents its own weakness at :115 — 'updated_at is a RECENCY proxy, not a true recurred-in-window event').
NET: the SD's core is NOT duplicate work. The claim justifying it is overstated and will not survive review as written.

== TASK 2: EXISTING INFRASTRUCTURE — CONFIRMED, with two caveats ==
lib/solomon/chairman-sms-exchanges.js CONFIRMED, 146 lines: DEFAULT_WINDOW_HOURS :32, foldIntoExchanges :51, phoneKey :86, readChairmanSmsExchanges :100. Pure SELECT over sms_relay_staging (:107) and sms_outbound_obligations (:111); refuses unbounded reads (:102); throws rather than returning [] on query error (:117-120). Reusable as-is for the bounded read.
CAVEAT A: it explicitly refuses similarity correlation (:43-46) and returns flat counts (:138-144). T1's clustering-by-question-class is NEW work, not reuse.
CAVEAT B: its only consumer, scripts/solomon/measure-chairman-sms-invisibility.mjs:24, is unwired and persists nothing — a one-shot stdout measurement.
Solomon GHA cron family CONFIRMED — 5 files (SD named 4): .github/workflows/solomon-duty-triggers-cron.yml (cron '37 11 * * *' daily + '20 8 * * 4' weekly, concurrency group, workflow_dispatch with weekly input, explicitly NOT var-gated and NOT fail-softed); solomon-ledger-reconcile.yml (cron '0 6 * * *', concurrency group solomon-ledger-reconcile, cancel-in-progress false, dry_run input) — THIS IS THE RIGHT TEMPLATE for a daily scan; solomon-ledger-resurface-cron.yml (cron '13,43 * * * *', cancel-in-progress true); solomon-judgment-expiry.yml — schedule COMMENTED OUT, dispatch-only, double-gated write path, ships deliberately disabled — WRONG TEMPLATE to copy, but its :22-25 docblock is the single most relevant lesson in the repo for this SD; plus solomon-late-verdict-reconcile-cron.yml (not named in the SD).

== TASK 3: TABLE / COLUMN REALITY — the asked blocking finding is REFUTED ==
feedback.category is NOT constrained. Verified three independent ways: (1) information_schema.columns — character varying(50), is_nullable=YES, no default; (2) pg_enum — udt_name is 'varchar', zero enum labels, NOT an enum type; (3) pg_constraint — I enumerated ALL 23 constraints on public.feedback (16 CHECK, 6 FK, 1 PK). The CHECKs cover ai_triage_confidence, ai_triage_source, duplicate/resolution references, terminal resolution, auto_correction_status, effort_estimate, feedback_type, rubric_score, severity, source_type, status, type, value_estimate. NONE references category. Both triggers (trg_log_feedback_resolution_violation, trigger_update_feedback_updated_at) are resolution/timestamp concerns, neither validates category.
Empirical corroboration: 58 distinct live category values, clearly added ad hoc over time (harness_backlog=5813 down to sms_relay=1). Length headroom fine — solomon_trend_candidate is 23 chars, solomon_trend_params is 20, against the 50 cap; the longest live value is pocock_weekly_deepening_failure at 31. Zero pre-existing rows with category ILIKE '%trend%'. NOT BLOCKING.
All named read-tables EXIST and carry usable history: feedback; session_coordination (3,725 rows but see V-1); issue_patterns (1,691; 2025-10-02 to 2026-08-05); retrospectives (8,448; 2025-09-24 to 2026-08-05); chairman_decisions (662; 2026-05-22 to 2026-08-07); merge_witness_telemetry (1,560; 2026-07-03 to 2026-08-05); sms_relay_staging (340; 2026-07-17 to 2026-08-07, keyed on received_at NOT created_at); sms_outbound_obligations (501); pattern_occurrences (EXISTS but 0 rows); retention_archive (508,792 rows total, 44,003 of them session_coordination).
The real BLOCKING-ADJACENT finding is V-1 (session_coordination is a survivor set) and the real INSERT hazard is W-1 (4 NOT NULL columns with 2 CHECK-constrained enumerations). Zero new tables remains ACHIEVABLE — including for T2, via retention_archive.

== TASK 4: OVERLAPPING SDs — no collision ==
Searched strategic_directives_v2 across title+description for trend, solomon, longitudinal, series, drift, recurrence, eyes, cluster (258 gross matches, almost all incidental 'solomon' mentions).
Tight overlap terms are decisive: 'longitudinal' -> 1 match (this SD). 'standing series' -> 1 (this SD). 'second set of eyes' -> 1 (this SD). 'trend detection' -> 0.
In-flight non-completed SDs matching solomon/trend: exactly one other, SD-FDBK-ENH-EHG-OPERATING-COMPANY-001 (active, PLAN_PRD, unclaimed) — operating-company substrate, unrelated domain. NO COLLISION.
Relevant COMPLETED prior art (cite, do not rebuild): SD-LEO-INFRA-CHAIRMAN-SMS-LANE-001 (built the reader this SD reuses, plus its read-only fence test); SD-LEO-INFRA-CONSULTANT-AGENT-PHASE-001/-002 (two trend detectors, both shipped unwired — see V-4); SD-LEO-INFRA-VISION-GAUGE-HISTORIZE-001 ('Historize the hourly vision-gauge run + show the trend' — the precedent for converting a point-event gauge into a series); SD-LEO-INFRA-NORMATIVE-SIGNAL-AUDIT-001 (enumerated every grading gauge — the source for the point-event characterization); SD-LEO-ENH-TREND-SCANNER-SCORING-001 (market-trend domain; naming-collision risk only).
Backlog check: sd_backlog_map not consulted — this SD is chairman-commissioned with a recorded GO (metadata.trend_eyes_go, SMS 8cafac9b, 'I approve Solomon's trend design') and carries 9 explicit success_criteria, which satisfies the scope-ambiguity concern the backlog rule exists to prevent.
